# Heading one

TOML frontmatter uses `+++` delimiters instead of `---`. Keys and values
should render with the same accent/muted/body-text colour treatment as
the YAML variant.

## What to look for

- `+++` delimiter lines → muted colour on the tinted background
- `key` → accent colour
- `=` separator → muted
- `"value"` / `false` / `[...]` → body text colour

---

Horizontal rule above is mid-document — not frontmatter.
